title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for review and approval of the Department of Telecommunications and Energy for a quasi-firm transportation service agreement with Clark University.
filings: The Department notes that pricing under the QF Agreement exceeds the Company's Marginal cost of providing the service, and therefore, the Agreement is hereby APPROVED. The Department finds that information regarding the pricing terms and minimum quantity of therms to be purchased under the Agreement is competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre Manning. (GC 00-13)
